replies.author: Mataric
replies.body:
I just looked at your other posts. You're either deranged, an idiot, or both.

Your game is not 'the first AI game', no matter how vehemently you argue that.  
Getting into using Dalle in 2022 is reasonably early, but you ignore that Dalle wasn't even near to the first AI model. It was built upon the success of a huge number of people who were developing and using models and methods that predate it.

Heck, even my friend group have technically made an AI game before you have - and we're a very small number of people.   
  
Your game has also released in 2025. You can't claim its the first when plenty of others released BEFORE that date. If I went back and used AI images I've generated before 2022 to make a game, that does not mean I've made an older AI game than you.

Most of the people in spaces like this have always been fans of AI generation. We haven't changed up our view. We were always here, using AI and making things with AI. You're just narcissistic enough to think you were alone in your adoption of a tool made by other people, for other people.
